svg.aria-label: sealg architecture: an agent or shell runs the sealg binary, a thin stateless MCP client, which forwards tools/list and tools/call over HTTPS to the per-user SealGate gateway, where all policy, trifecta, and PII enforcement live before reaching connectors. The doctor command is local only and never touches the gateway.
